reference_sql:
SELECT order_month,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS lines_per_order
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY order_month
alternatives: SELECT order_month, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS lines_per_order FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_month
SELECT order_month, ROUND(COUNT(order_line_id) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 2) AS lines_per_order FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT order_month, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS lines_per_order FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_month
other_way.tradeoff: Two comparisons give the same rows, but BETWEEN states the range in one short test.
